mapper.update: update dimension_image set collects = collects + 1 where id = #{imageId};
update dimension_image set collects = collects - 1 where id = #{imageId};
mapper.select: SELECT di.id di_id, di.category_id di_category_id, di.url di_url, di.score di_score, di.collects di_collects, di.create_time di_create_time,di.comments di_comments, di.votes di_votes, di.views di_views, dwh.id dwh_id,dwh.user_id dwh_user_id,dwh.image_id dwh_image_id, dwh.create_time dwh_create_time FROM dimension_image di INNER JOIN dimension_image_bookmark dwh ON di.id = dwh.image_id WHERE dwh.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY dwh.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageNum}, #{pageSize}
select dt.* from dimension_tag dt inner join dimension_tag_image_relation dtir on dt.id = dtir.tag_id where dtir.image_id = #{categoryId};
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dimension_image_bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId}
select * from dimension_image_bookmark where user_id = #{userId} and image_id = #{imageId}
delete from dimension_image_bookmark where user_id = #{userId} and image_id = #{imageId}
